purpose: Independent practice of C2.2 (testing equivalence of expression pairs).
student_learning_goal: I can decide if two addition or subtraction expressions are equal.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can decide if two addition or subtraction expressions are equal.
header.character_watermark: Bella in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Six expression-pair rows.

image_placeholders.description: Six expression-pair rows in B&W line-art, stacked vertically. Each ~7in × 0.7in. Format: expression on left, blank middle (= / ≠ bubbles), expression on right. Pairs: 5+3 vs 4+4, 6+3 vs 5+4, 8-2 vs 4+1, 7+1 vs 9-1, 10-3 vs 5+2, 4+4 vs 4+5.
image_placeholders.placement: Top of the page; six rows.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_SIX_PAIRS: keywords (equal, pair) name what the rows ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Each balance shows expressions on each pan. Write = or ≠ AND draw whether the balance is level or tipped.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Four balance scale drawings in 2x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Four balance scale drawings in B&W line-art, 2-row × 2-column grid. Each ~3in × 2in. Pre-fills: B1 left=5+3, right=4+4; B2 left=6+1, right=5+3; B3 left=10-2, right=4+4; B4 left=7-3, right=2+3. Each balance has empty pivot — child draws level/tipped.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_FOUR_BALANCES: keywords (balance, scale) name what the drawings ask for.

parts.answer_key: B1: =, level (both 8). B2: ≠, tipped right (7 ≠ 8). B3: =, level (both 8). B4: ≠, tipped right (4 ≠ 5).

parts.student_instructions: Write your own pair of expressions that are EQUAL. Then write your own pair that are NOT EQUAL.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Two writing slots.

image_placeholders.description: Two writing slots in B&W line-art, stacked. Each ~7in × 1in. Top: 'EQUAL: ___ ___ ___'. Bottom: 'NOT EQUAL: ___ ___ ___'. Bella thinking-bubble icon top-right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_MY_OWN: keywords (equal, not-equal) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any pair that's correctly equal/not equal.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find 3 more expression pairs in the classroom that ARE equal. Write them on the back.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Watch Part 1 children who reject 5+3=4+4 — flag for the operator-misconception reteach.
